Wise hung on to on the 4th leg, but Frank Wright could not hold Barton of Southgate, who is the Southern Youth c.c. champion, over the final stage.
This was followed by a very pleasing presentation of a cup by Len Marchant to F.

Frank Wright ran a good race to finish 2nd in the junior 880, after being badly spiked, and our team were 2nd in the 4 x 110 yds relay. Geoff Goode was 4th in the 1 mile team race and our team occupied the same position, but D.

Frank Wright won the 880 junior race and not only beat the old record of 2 min. 2.8 secs., but also won for himself a trophy given by Len Marchant, the previous record-holder, to any member beating his time.

As at this meeting it is the custom to give prizes for the first six in each event, it will be seen that our lads had a very profitable afternoon. Benstead was 3rd in the junior 100 final and then won the 220 yards, while Frank Wright won the junior 880, and Geoff.
Henn, our Oxford University member, in second place and Frank Wright really showed the locals some running by "walking" the junior race over this distance.
Frank Wright was third in the individual race and it was interesting to note that we had our six counters home before any of the other teams, but our lads packed a little too far back.

Benstead was 3rd in the Southern Junior 220 yards, while Frank Wright was 3rd in the A.A.A. Junior 880 yards and also finished 3rd in the Junior half-mile at the British Games meeting in the fine time of 1 min. 57.4 secs.

Held on June 24th as a Senior and Junior match with Herne Hill H. and Mitcham A.C. as our opponents. In the Junior events we saw Frank Wright win the 880 yds. in 2 mins. 0.9 secs., with A.

Baines also failed in his heat of the 880 yds., but Frank Wright qualified for the final of this event by being placed 2nd in his heat. Whether it was due to his Army training, the fact remains that Frank could not get a place in the final and so vanished our last hope of a winner's medal.

Our 4 x 110 yds. team failed to materialize and in the 4 x 440 yds. we were fifth. Frank Wright, Pat Fox, Alan Jackson and Brian Morris constituted our team. The medley relay saw us finish in 6th place.

Our own John Davies, Brian Morris, Clive Ryan, Frank Wright and D. McCorquindale were competing elsewhere, and with Stan Vickers Eric Hall, Norman Caves, Mal Ash and Andorka also unavailable our team could not be said to be truly representative of the name of Belgrave.

Whilst talking of half miling we must congratulate Dave Cocks on setting up a new club Junior best of 1:56.4 - a performance which whilst it seemed inevitable, does erase from the book one of the most long-standing club records set up almost ten years ago by Frank Wright.

He bounced back for the road relays in scintillating form, winning our Club youth trial from County Champion Frank Wright and then recording third fastest time of the day in the popular Aylesbury Youth Relay.

Our Youths performed well in 4th place led home by Frank Wright in 7th. The short road relay season followed the National closely and at Ilford in the 10 x 3½ miles race we entered three teams.
